name: 50014 · Ames, IA
findings: ZIP 50014 (Ames) has 122 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50014 (Ames) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 50014 (Ames) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.2 times the typical level).
